At first I felt worried because I did not want anyone to lose a book. My friend suggested that we check each shelf together. We compared the books with the list and found the missing titles. Nobody lost anything. After we finished, we cleaned the tables and returned the chairs to their places. The librarian thanked us for keeping the room tidy. I learned that asking for help is better than hiding a mistake. I also learned to check my work before people arrive. Next month we will hold another exchange, and I am going to prepare a clearer list. I want every student to feel welcome, even if they can only bring one book. I felt proud when everyone left with the correct books.
